g.text: Low-voltage controller only. No mains on this PCB.

g.desc: Low-voltage controller only. No mains on this PCB.

g.text: ULN2003A/G6K pickup margin requires bench validation.

g.desc: ULN2003A/G6K pickup margin requires bench validation.

g.text: NO PCB MAINS. Do not update the old PCB from this schematic until layout work is authorised.

g.desc: NO PCB MAINS. Do not update the old PCB from this schematic until layout work is authorised.

g.text: DC input only. G7L mains contacts and all 230V wiring are chassis-mounted off-board.

g.desc: DC input only. G7L mains contacts and all 230V wiring are chassis-mounted off-board.

g.text: PE remains continuous and is never switched. Supply GND is the controller ground only.

g.desc: PE remains continuous and is never switched. Supply GND is the controller ground only.

g.text: D1 reverse-polarity blocking; F1 limits fault current; D2 clamps short input transients.

g.desc: D1 reverse-polarity blocking; F1 limits fault current; D2 clamps short input transients.

g.text: Not a sustained-overvoltage disconnect. Use only the specified regulated adapter.

g.desc: Not a sustained-overvoltage disconnect. Use only the specified regulated adapter.

g.text: SS14 drop reduces the coil/buck input slightly below the adapter voltage.

g.desc: SS14 drop reduces the coil/buck input slightly below the adapter voltage.

g.text: 5V supply: 2A capacity. Budget 1.1A including both SPU03 modules.

g.desc: 5V supply: 2A capacity. Budget 1.1A including both SPU03 modules.

g.text: Detector preloads dissipate about 1.67W total at nominal voltage.

g.desc: Detector preloads dissipate about 1.67W total at nominal voltage.

g.text: 12V adapter >=1A; input fuse T1A. Verify startup and temperatures.

g.desc: 12V adapter >=1A; input fuse T1A. Verify startup and temperatures.

g.text: Ripple/EMI and fuse coordination remain bench/layout checks.

g.desc: Ripple/EMI and fuse coordination remain bench/layout checks.
